summary: VSee Health filed an 8-K disclosing a Settlement Agreement with ADI Funding LLC and M2B Funding Corp. resolving default claims on a secured promissory note (original principal $271,739.13) from June 8, 2026. Terms require repayment within 90 days or upon financing proceeds; 50% of gross proceeds from any financing (100% from ELOC) go to ADI. The agreement releases disputes over alleged failures to file a resale registration statement, an 8-K, and issue transfer agent instructions. Watch for the company's ability to secure financing to avoid immediate repayment default.
